name: POST /admin/sovereign/bundles/:release_id/applied — api-gateway
description: Marks a previously shipped sovereign bundle release as applied in the target region, closing the ship→apply loop, and returns { success: true, data: <release> }. Takes no request body — the release_id path param is the entire input. QA edge cases: an unknown release_id is a clean 404 "release not found" because markSovereignBundleApplied() returning null is handled explicitly; release_id is not format-validated, so arbitrary strings are looked up and simply miss (or fail a uuid cast and become a 500 if the column is a UUID); re-marking an already-applied release depends on whether markSovereignBundleApplied still returns the row — assert the returned status rather than assuming clean idempotency; sending a body is harmless and ignored.

errorCases.when: requireAdmin() found no valid x-admin-ops-token header — missing, or matching neither env ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN nor an active admin.ops_token hash (30s cache TTL applies to revocations)
markSovereignBundleApplied(release_id) returns null/undefined — no release row matches that release_id
markSovereignBundleApplied() throws — release_id failing a uuid cast, or Postgres unavailable

testCases.name: Mark a previously-shipped sovereign bundle release as applied
